details.report:
Committed 72d14d9840855be73163bd36d4866d11b177cab4. The accepted batch now owns all-leg settlement through permanent Agent/spawn lockout; Agent results expose settlement evidence but no child prose. A dedicated settlement assembler constructs RuntimeReviewerReceiptV2 with axis-keyed verbatim reports, exact UTF-8 lengths/SHA-256, outcomes, target, bundle/recipe, prompt-record, and canonical Skill identity. Reviewer output is now completed intent only or refused intent plus a separate nonblank diagnostic; completed requires every expected success, refused after acceptance requires every terminal outcome, known child/provider failures remain truthful outcomes, and unknown infrastructure/audit failures remain fatal. Audit is narrowed to method/identity, distinct-question, and exact-preservation checks and explicitly excludes source allowlists and finding merit. Reviewer output/package/auditor/failure fixtures were migrated once with no aggregate compatibility path. Stale Judge/Fixer typed-schema expectations and the continue fixture were updated without weakening production validation. Soul unchanged.

Validation: focused Reviewer/Judge/audit/package tests passed; typecheck passed; isolated-HOME full suite passed (314 pass, 0 fail, 5 skipped); cold-installed package lifecycle passed; npm pack --dry-run passed; git diff --check passed; worktree clean.
